Theoretical kappa_r(log T_N) for r=2..r_max. Independent of T_0 by construction; relies only on the shape vector a and branch s. a may be empty (N = 0), for which all cumulants are 0.

Source: R/identifiability.R
log_cumulants_theory.Rd

Theoretical kappa_r(log T_N) for r=2..r_max. Independent of T_0 by construction; relies only on the shape vector a and branch s. a may be empty (N = 0), for which all cumulants are 0.

Usage

log_cumulants_theory(a, s, r_max = 4L)

Arguments

a

Numeric vector of per-level shape parameters (a_1, ..., a_N); length is the cascade depth N (empty for N = 0).

s

Universality class: 0.5 (gamma / stretched-exponential) or 1 (inverse-gamma / power-law).

r_max

Highest cumulant order to compute (cumulants of order 2..r_max are returned).

Value

See details.
